release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.5.8 Release:
• Slab Chair Heights Summary Table: Fixed table splitting to strictly honor the split-by-rows configuration (generates a unified single table when disabled).
• Grout Volume Calculation: Displayed in Liters with cubic meters in parentheses across schedules, CAD drawings, and Excel exports, with total volume row and summary.
• Rebar Dimension Alignment: Column rebar dimension lines strictly aligned flush with drop panel boundaries and centered on columns.
• Clash Detection Tuning: Dynamic duct height and layered contact classification improvements.
